about.title: Empowering Agriculture with Artificial Intelligence
about.subtitle: AgroFarming is an AI-powered Smart Farming System designed to help farmers make informed decisions using modern technologies such as Machine Learning, Weather Forecasting, Crop Recommendation, Disease Detection, and Fertilizer Recommendation.
about.heading: Who We Are
about.description1: AgroFarming is a digital agriculture platform that combines Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics to provide intelligent farming solutions. Our goal is to simplify farming by delivering accurate recommendations and real-time insights.
about.description2: The platform enables farmers to improve productivity, reduce risks, optimize resource usage, and adopt sustainable agricultural practices through easy-to-use AI tools.
about.aiDesc: Advanced Machine Learning models provide smart farming recommendations.
about.greenDesc: Promoting environmentally friendly and efficient farming practices.
about.multiDesc: Available in both English and Hindi for better accessibility.
about.missionSubtitle: Creating smarter, sustainable and technology-driven agriculture for every farmer.
about.mission1Desc: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence to simplify agricultural decision making.
about.mission2Desc: Providing accurate predictions and recommendations using modern technologies.
about.mission3Desc: Building user-friendly digital solutions focused on farmers' needs.
about.visionText: Our vision is to empower every farmer with intelligent digital solutions that increase productivity, improve sustainability, and make modern agriculture accessible to everyone.

advice.lowRainfall: Lower rainfall conditions may require additional irrigation planning.

advice.warmDry: Consider crops and varieties that can tolerate relatively warm and dry conditions.
advice.rainfallDisease: Higher rainfall and humidity can increase fungal disease risk. Monitor crops regularly.
advice.normal: Climate conditions are relatively moderate. Continue normal seasonal farming practices.
